**11. Confidence & Trust Logic**

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Confidence        **Threshold and behaviour**
  Level**             
  ------------------- ---------------------------------------------------
  **0--40% --- Weak** Do not assume. May ask for clarification.

  **41--60% ---       Confirm before proceeding.
  Directional**       

  **61--80% ---       Proceed cautiously with confirmation available.
  Reliable**          

  **81--95% ---       Low-friction operation. Light escalation.
  High**              

  **96--100% ---      Silent confidence. No ask needed.
  Deterministic**     
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

Principle: CorpStage earns trust by exposing uncertainty, not hiding it.

                                synthesis) · Top Leadership Attention
                                Areas · Emerging Contradictions ·
                                Financially Material Signals ·
                                Confidence-Aware Intelligence ·
                                Recommended Leadership Discussions ·
                                Guided Navigation to deeper screens.

  **Confidence Logic**          81--95% → surface with strong
                                recommendation · 96--100% → act silently,
                                deterministic truth · 61--80% → surface
                                cautiously · 41--60% → directional signal
                                only · \<40% → suppress unless highly
                                material. Screen 1: orient, occasionally
                                clarify, rarely ask.

  **Success Definition**        Executives regain situational clarity ·
                                noise is suppressed · what matters
                                becomes obvious · contradictions surface
                                early · financial meaning is clear ·
                                leadership naturally moves deeper.
                                Primary metric: Executive Clarity Per
                                Minute.
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **14 Key Design Principles --- Screen 1**                             |
|                                                                       |
| Orient before analysis · Synthesize, don\'t summarize · Surface       |
| meaning, suppress noise · Show contradictions calmly · Translate into |
| financial terms · Confidence shapes tone · Recommend, never decide ·  |
| Executive attention is scarce                                         |
+=======================================================================+
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+

| 14.2.2** |                                                           |
|          |                                                           |
| C        |                                                           |
| ondensed |                                                           |

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **SIM Element**                 **Definition**
  ------------------------------- ---------------------------------------
  **Screen Purpose**              Provide leadership with an intelligent
                                  view of enterprise condition --- where
                                  the organization is healthy, fragile,
                                  strengthening, or weakening. Not KPI
                                  dashboard. Not performance reporting.
                                  Feels like: an enterprise MRI.

  **Executive Question**          \"Where is the enterprise healthy,
                                  fragile, strengthening or weakening?\"
                                  Sub-questions: Where are
                                  vulnerabilities emerging? What domains
                                  need attention? What is improving? What
                                  is deteriorating?

  **Organisational Truth**        \"How healthy is the enterprise
                                  systemically?\" Health is: dynamic,
                                  directional and confidence-adjusted.
                                  Screen 2 synthesizes: operational
                                  health · financial health · supplier &
                                  ecosystem resilience · workforce
                                  strength · governance consistency ·
                                  enterprise adaptability.

  **Emotional Intent**            Desired state: Calm diagnosis,
                                  Situational confidence, Clarity without
                                  alarm. Tone: premium · calm · medically
                                  intelligent · boardroom-grade. Feels
                                  like: organizational diagnostics.

  **AI Synthesis Logic**          Enterprise Health Intelligence (overall
                                  condition) · Hidden Fragility Detection
                                  (weaknesses not yet visible) ·
                                  Cross-Domain Health Intelligence
                                  (interconnected deterioration) · Trend
                                  Intelligence: improving / stable /
                                  weakening / deteriorating --- never
                                  static · Confidence-Adjusted Health
                                  (health influenced by certainty
                                  quality).

  **Executive Output**            Enterprise Health Overview · Domain
                                  Health View · Health Trajectory
                                  (improving vs deteriorating) · Emerging
                                  Vulnerabilities · Cross-Domain Risks ·
                                  Confidence-Aware Health · Suggested
                                  Navigation to Decision Center,
                                  Executive Foresight (Screen 4),
                                  Executive Vigilance (Phase 15).

  **Success Definition**          Enterprise condition becomes visible ·
                                  deterioration appears early · fragility
                                  becomes understandable · leadership
                                  prioritizes intelligently · executives
                                  naturally go deeper. Primary metric:
                                  Speed of Enterprise Condition
                                  Understanding.

| **       | **Screen 3 --- Decision Center**                          |
| 14.2.3** |                                                           |
|          |                                                           |
| Full     |                                                           |
+==========+===========================================================+
+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **SIM Element**                 **Definition**
  ------------------------------- ---------------------------------------
  **Screen Purpose**              Transform enterprise intelligence into
                                  decision-grade recommendations. Helps
                                  leadership: understand available
                                  choices · evaluate trade-offs · compare
                                  consequences · assess confidence ·
                                  approve, reject, defer, or request
                                  clarification. System recommends.
                                  Humans decide.

  **Executive Question**          \"What should we do now --- and why?\"
                                  Secondary: What are the best available
                                  actions? What is the business impact?
                                  What are the risks of acting vs not
                                  acting? How confident is the
                                  recommendation?

  **Organisational Truth**        Organizations rarely fail from lack of
                                  data. They fail because: signals remain
                                  fragmented · decisions become
                                  opinion-driven · trade-offs remain
                                  invisible · confidence is unclear ·
                                  accountability is diffused. Decision
                                  quality determines enterprise quality.

  **Emotional Intent**            Executive should feel: Clarity over
                                  confusion. Not: \"There is too much
                                  information.\" But: \"I understand the
                                  choices, risks, and likely
                                  consequences.\" Reduces: decision
                                  fatigue · ambiguity · organizational
                                  noise.

  **AI Synthesis Logic**          1\. Detect decision moments → 2.
                                  Generate options (Accelerate / Phase
                                  rollout / Pause) → 3. Evaluate
                                  trade-offs across risk, financial
                                  impact, speed, compliance, execution
                                  complexity → 4. Simulate outcomes
                                  (likely impact, downside risk,
                                  second-order effects) → 5. Recommend
                                  action (explainable + traceable +
                                  evidence-backed).

  **Financial Meaning**           Every decision translates into: revenue
                                  effect · margin impact · EBITDA
                                  sensitivity · cost exposure ·
                                  risk-adjusted value · capital
                                  implications · timing implications. No
                                  recommendation exists without economic
                                  meaning.

  **Executive Output**            Recommended Action · Decision rationale
                                  · Trade-off visibility · Confidence
                                  score · Required stakeholders
                                  (Confirm/Correct/Enter) · Audit trail.

  **Success Definition**          Decisions happen faster · decision
                                  quality improves · trade-offs become
                                  visible · executive confidence improves
                                  · fewer escalations occur · decision
                                  rationale becomes auditable.

  **Screen Purpose**              Identify material risks and

                                  anticipation over reaction. Helps
                                  leadership: anticipate disruptions ·
                                  detect emerging upside · understand

  **Executive Question**          \"What can materially help us --- or
                                  hurt us?\" Secondary: What risks are
                                  emerging? What opportunities are being
                                  missed? What requires early action?
                                  Where are concentrations forming?

  **Organisational Truth**        Most enterprise failures are visible
                                  early. Organizations miss them because:
                                  signals appear fragmented · ownership
                                  is unclear · weak signals get ignored ·
                                  opportunities remain buried in
                                  functions. Organizations rarely fail
                                  suddenly --- they fail progressively.

  **AI Synthesis Logic**          1\. Detect weak signals (patterns
                                  before materialization) → 2. Cluster
                                  intelligence (combine signals across
                                  domains) → 3. Assess materiality
                                  (business impact, probability, urgency,
                                  persistence) → 4. Predict trajectory
                                  (improving/stable/deteriorating) → 5.
                                  Prioritize (materiality × urgency ×
                                  confidence) → 6. Recommend action
                                  (monitor, mitigate, escalate, invest,
                                  accelerate).

  **Executive Output**            Prioritized Risk Register · Prioritized
                                  Opportunity Register · Early Warning
                                  Indicators · Risk/Opportunity
                                  Trajectory · Recommended Actions ·
                                  Stakeholder Accountability · Evidence
                                  Trail.

  **Success Definition**          Risks identified earlier ·
                                  opportunities surfaced sooner ·
                                  surprises decrease · resilience
                                  improves · proactive interventions
                                  increase · enterprise blind spots
                                  reduce.

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **SIM Element**                 **Definition**
  ------------------------------- ---------------------------------------
  **Screen Purpose**              Help leadership focus on what matters
                                  most now. Converts overwhelming
                                  enterprise intelligence into
                                  prioritized executive attention. Focus:
                                  priority over volume.

  **Executive Question**          \"What deserves our attention first?\"
                                  Secondary: What is most material right
                                  now? What can wait? What requires
                                  escalation? Where should leadership
                                  intervene first?

  **Organisational Truth**        Organizations do not fail because they
                                  lack intelligence. They fail because:
                                  everything becomes priority ·
                                  leadership attention fragments · urgent
                                  overwhelms important. If everything is
                                  critical, nothing is critical.

  **AI Synthesis Logic**          1\. Ingest competing signals across all
                                  domains → 2. Suppress noise (low
                                  materiality, duplicates, isolated
                                  anomalies, low-confidence noise) → 3.
                                  Calculate priority score: Materiality ×
                                  Urgency × Confidence × Business Impact,
                                  adjusted by strategic importance,
                                  financial consequence, dependency
                                  effect → 4. Sequence action: Immediate
                                  / Near-term / Monitor / Deprioritize →
                                  5. Explain prioritization (why this
                                  matters now).

  **Executive Output**            Prioritized Action Queue · Enterprise
                                  Priority Ranking · Attention Heatmap ·
                                  Escalation Queue · Recommended
                                  Sequencing (now/next/later) ·
                                  Stakeholder Ownership · Evidence Trail.

  **Success Definition**          Executive focus improves · signal
                                  overload decreases · important issues
                                  surface earlier · prioritization
                                  becomes explainable · escalation
                                  quality improves · time-to-decision
                                  decreases.

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **SIM Element**                 **Definition**
  ------------------------------- ---------------------------------------
  **Screen Purpose**              Ensure the enterprise can move fast
                                  without losing control. Focus: enable
                                  business through governance --- not
                                  slow it down.

  **Executive Question**          \"Are we operating safely, responsibly,
                                  and accountably?\" Secondary: Where are
                                  governance gaps? What compliance
                                  exposure exists? Are controls working?

  **Organisational Truth**        Organizations rarely fail because
                                  \"they ignored governance.\" They fail
                                  because governance became invisible
                                  until something broke. Common failures:
                                  delayed compliance response ·
                                  fragmented accountability · weak
                                  control execution · poor evidence
                                  traceability. Good governance enables
                                  speed. Bad governance creates friction.
                                  No governance creates risk.

  **AI Synthesis Logic**          1\. Map obligations (internal,
                                  external, reporting, governance
                                  expectations) → 2. Detect exposure
                                  (policy breach + missing approval +
                                  weak evidence → governance risk) → 3.
                                  Measure control effectiveness
                                  (Effective/At Risk/Failed) → 4.
                                  Identify accountability gaps → 5.
                                  Recommend intervention (remediate,
                                  escalate, strengthen controls, assign
                                  ownership, update policy, improve
                                  evidence).

  **Executive Output**            Governance Health View · Compliance
                                  Exposure Register · Control
                                  Effectiveness View · Accountability
                                  Heatmap · Remediation Priorities ·
                                  Stakeholder Accountability · Evidence
                                  Trail (audit-ready references and
                                  lineage).

  **Success Definition**          Compliance surprises decrease ·
                                  governance gaps surface earlier ·
                                  accountability improves · audit
                                  readiness strengthens · remediation
                                  speeds increase · control failures
                                  reduce · trust improves · business
                                  moves faster with confidence.

  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **SIM Element**                 **Definition**
  ------------------------------- -----------------------------------------
  **Screen Purpose**              Enable leadership to intervene precisely
                                  where executive action creates
                                  disproportionate impact. Focus: intervene
                                  where leadership matters most.

  **Executive Question**          \"Where should leadership step in now?\"
                                  Secondary: What requires executive
                                  attention? What is stalled or
                                  deteriorating? Where are decisions
                                  blocked? Which intervention creates
                                  highest impact?

  **Organisational Truth**        Most enterprise problems do not need
                                  executive intervention. But some problems
                                  cannot move without it. Organizations
                                  slow down when: escalations happen too
                                  late · leaders intervene everywhere ·
                                  bottlenecks remain unresolved. Poor
                                  intervention creates dependency. No
                                  intervention creates drift. Good
                                  intervention unlocks execution.

  **AI Synthesis Logic**          1\. Detect intervention moments
                                  (situations needing leadership
                                  involvement) → 2. Assess intervention
                                  value (will executive involvement
                                  materially improve outcome?) → 3.
                                  Prioritize (business materiality,
                                  urgency, escalation severity, execution
                                  impact, financial consequence) → 4.
                                  Recommend intervention type
                                  (Decide/Escalate/Align/Accelerate/Stop) →
                                  5. Predict intervention impact (expected
                                  improvement, risk reduction, time
                                  acceleration).

  **Executive Output**            Intervention Queue (highest-value first)
                                  · Escalation Register · Bottleneck Map ·
                                  Predicted Intervention Impact ·
                                  Recommended Actions · Stakeholder
                                  Accountability · Evidence Trail.

  **Success Definition**          Bottlenecks reduce · execution
                                  accelerates · escalations become timely ·
                                  executive attention improves · stalled
                                  decisions decline · leadership
                                  effectiveness increases · accountability
                                  improves.
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------

| 4.2.12** |                                                           |
|          |                                                           |
| Full     |                                                           |

+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **SIM Element**                 **Definition**
  ------------------------------- ---------------------------------------
  **Screen Purpose**              Provide leadership with a single
                                  trusted executive readiness view before
                                  major action. Focus: enterprise
                                  readiness before commitment.

  **Executive Question**          \"Are we truly ready to move forward?\"
                                  Secondary: Are major risks understood?
                                  Are critical dependencies resolved? Is
                                  execution realistically achievable? Are
                                  stakeholders aligned?

  **Organisational Truth**        Organizations often move because \"the
                                  plan looks ready.\" But plans fail
                                  when: readiness is assumed · unresolved
                                  risks are ignored · alignment is
                                  incomplete · dependencies remain hidden
                                  · optimism exceeds evidence. Readiness
                                  is not confidence. Readiness is:
                                  evidence-backed preparedness.

  **AI Synthesis Logic**          1\. Aggregate readiness signals across
                                  all intelligence domains → 2. Evaluate
                                  readiness dimensions (strategic,
                                  financial, execution, organizational,
                                  governance) → 3. Identify unresolved
                                  gaps (missing approvals, unresolved
                                  risks, capability shortfalls) → 4.
                                  Calculate readiness posture
                                  (Ready/Conditionally Ready/Not Ready) →
                                  5. Recommend next action (proceed,
                                  phase rollout, delay, escalate,
                                  strengthen readiness).

  **Executive Output**            Executive Readiness Score · Readiness
                                  Heatmap (strong vs weak) · Critical
                                  Gaps Register · Residual Risk View ·
                                  Recommended Next Action
                                  (Proceed/Delay/Mitigate/Escalate) ·
                                  Stakeholder Accountability · Evidence
                                  Trail.

  **Success Definition**          Readiness becomes measurable · failed
                                  execution reduces · executive
                                  confidence improves · avoidable
                                  surprises decrease · unresolved
                                  blockers surface earlier · alignment
                                  strengthens · decision quality
                                  improves.

  **14.3 --- Cross-Screen Architecture SIM**
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
| **       | **Sacred 12 Interaction Model --- Cross-Screen            |
| 14.3.1** | Orchestration**                                           |
|          |                                                           |
| Full     |                                                           |
+==========+===========================================================+
+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+

The Sacred 12 must function as one executive cognition system --- not
isolated screens. The model ensures: intelligence continuity · signal
propagation · decision consistency · cognitive sequencing ·
enterprise-wide context retention.

**Sacred 12 Cognitive Flow**

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Screen**                      **Role in cognitive sequence**
  ------------------------------- ---------------------------------------
  **Screen 1 → Executive Home**   Starting point. Surfaces: what matters
                                  now.

  **Screen 2 → Enterprise Health  Understands: what is happening.
  Map**                           

  **Screen 4 → Risk & Opportunity Anticipates: what could help or hurt.
  Center**                        

  **Screen 5 → Intelligence       Determines: what matters most.
  Prioritization Center**         

  **Screen 8 → Pattern &          Explains: what keeps repeating.
  Behavioral Intelligence         
  Center**                        

  **Screen 9 → Scenario & Future  Tests: possible futures.
  Simulation Center**             

  **Screen 3 → Decision Center**  Recommends: what should be done.

  **Screen 6 → Execution          Validates: can we execute.
  Readiness Center**              

  **Screen 7 → Organizational     Checks: are we aligned.
  Alignment Center**              

  **Screen 10 → Governance &      Ensures: can we move responsibly.
  Compliance Center**             

  **Screen 11 → Executive         Determines: where leadership matters.
  Intervention Center**           

  **Screen 12 → Executive         Concludes: are we truly ready.
  Readiness Center**              
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Intelligence Persistence Logic --- Signals Never Reset**            |
|                                                                       |
| A supplier disruption detected once appears automatically in: Screen  |
| 2 (health deterioration) → Screen 4 (risk signal) → Screen 5          |
| (priority increase) → Screen 3 (decision recommendation) → Screen 6   |
| (execution impact) → Screen 12 (readiness recalculation).             |
|                                                                       |
| Enterprise memory persists. The system is living intelligence --- not |
| periodic reporting.                                                   |
+=======================================================================+
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+

+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
| **       | **Cross-Screen Signal Propagation**                       |
| 14.3.2** |                                                           |
|          |                                                           |
| Full     |                                                           |
+==========+===========================================================+
+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+

One enterprise signal propagates across the Sacred 12. Intelligence
continuity without duplication. A signal should: travel automatically ·
evolve contextually · change recommendations · affect priorities ·
influence readiness.

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Signal Category**             **Primary flow and examples**
  ------------------------------- ---------------------------------------
  **Risk Signals**                Supplier disruption, cyber incident,
                                  regulatory change, concentration risk.
                                  Primary flow: 2 → 4 → 5 → 3 → 6 → 10 →
                                  11 → 12

  **Financial Signals**           Margin deterioration, revenue slowdown,
                                  liquidity pressure. Primary flow: 2 → 5
                                  → 3 → 9 → 6 → 12

  **Opportunity Signals**         Market opening, acquisition target,
                                  capability advantage. Primary flow: 4 →
                                  5 → 9 → 3 → 6 → 12

  **Execution Signals**           Delivery delays, capability shortage,
                                  vendor failure. Primary flow: 6 → 5 → 3
                                  → 11 → 12

  **Governance Signals**          Control failure, audit finding,
                                  approval breach. Primary flow: 10 → 5 →
                                  3 → 11 → 12

  **Behavioral Signals**          Recurring delays, repeated escalations,
                                  leadership dependency. Primary flow: 8
                                  → 5 → 3 → 7 → 11 → 12
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Signal State Evolution**                                            |
|                                                                       |
| Detection (signal identified) → Contextualization (business meaning   |
| understood) → Prioritization (materiality assessed) → Recommendation  |
| (action proposed) → Readiness Impact (execution feasibility tested) → |
| Executive Intervention (leadership involvement triggered) → Readiness |
| Recalculation (enterprise posture updated). Signals mature across     |
| screens --- they do not repeat.                                       |
+=======================================================================+
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+

| **       | **Confidence Propagation Model**                          |
| 14.3.4** |                                                           |
|          |                                                           |
| Full     |                                                           |
+==========+===========================================================+
+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+

Confidence is not isolated --- it is contagious. Confidence travels,
evolves, and recalculates across the Sacred 12.

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Confidence Level**            **Characteristics and system
                                  behaviour**
  ------------------------------- ---------------------------------------
  **High Confidence**             Strong evidence, corroborated signals,
                                  high consistency. System behaviour:
                                  strong recommendation, reduced
                                  friction, faster executive path.
                                  Example: \"Proceed recommended.\"

  **Medium Confidence**           Partial evidence, moderate consistency,
                                  some uncertainty. System behaviour:
                                  conditional recommendation, validation
                                  requested. Example: \"Proceed with
                                  mitigation.\"

  **Low Confidence**              Missing evidence, conflicting signals,
                                  unstable assumptions. System behaviour:
                                  escalation triggered, human review
                                  mandatory. Example: \"Insufficient
                                  confidence to recommend.\"
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Confidence Propagation Example**                                    |
|                                                                       |
| Weak Risk Confidence (Screen 4) → Priority downgraded (Screen 5) →    |
| Conditional recommendation (Screen 3) → Scenario validation added     |
| (Screen 9) → Readiness reduced (Screen 12)                            |
|                                                                       |
| Confidence inputs: Evidence Quality · Source Reliability · Data       |
| Completeness · Signal Consistency · Recency · Historical Accuracy ·   |
| Assumption Stability · Stakeholder Validation                         |
+=======================================================================+
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+

+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
| **       | **Human-in-the-Loop Orchestration**                       |
| 14.3.5** |                                                           |
|          |                                                           |
| Full     |                                                           |
+==========+===========================================================+
+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+

AI-assisted enterprise cognition with human accountability. The model
ensures: humans remain accountable · AI recommendations stay governed ·
decisions remain explainable · enterprise trust increases.

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Interaction       **Definition and purpose**
  Type**              
  ------------------- ---------------------------------------------------
  **Confirm**         Human validates recommendation. Examples: approve
                      prioritization, accept readiness view, confirm risk
                      assessment. Purpose: speed.

  **Correct**         Human adjusts system interpretation. Examples:
                      change priority weighting, override recommendation,
                      refine assumptions. Purpose: judgment.

  **Enter**           Human adds missing intelligence. Examples: missing
                      business context, regulatory clarification,
                      stakeholder input. Purpose: completeness.
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Executive Role**              **Primary screens and focus**
  ------------------------------- ---------------------------------------
  **CEO**                         Enterprise priorities, strategic
                                  decisions, executive interventions,
                                  readiness. Primary screens: 1, 3, 5,
                                  11, 12.

  **CFO**                         Financial implications, capital
                                  exposure, scenario economics. Primary
                                  screens: 3, 5, 9, 12.

  **COO**                         Execution readiness, operational
                                  bottlenecks. Primary screens: 2, 6, 7,
                                  11.

  **CRO / Risk Leader**           Enterprise exposure, risk mitigation.
                                  Primary screens: 4, 5, 10.

  **Compliance / Legal**          Obligations, policy exposure. Primary
                                  screens: 10, 12.

  **Business Leaders**            Domain decisions, operational action.
                                  Primary screens: 2, 3, 6, 7.
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
| **       | **Invisible Compliance Propagation**                      |
| 14.3.6** |                                                           |
|          |                                                           |
| Full     |                                                           |
+==========+===========================================================+
+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+

Governance, auditability, accountability, evidence, and compliance
travel silently across CorpStage. The objective is enterprise trust
without operational friction. Compliance never dominates the experience.
Business-first execution with invisible trust architecture.

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Compliance Component**        **What it tracks and answers**
  ------------------------------- ---------------------------------------
  **Governance Propagation**      Tracks: decision rights · approval
                                  authority · escalation rules ·
                                  ownership boundaries. Automatically
                                  validates: who is allowed to decide.

  **Evidence Propagation**        Tracks: source lineage · supporting
                                  intelligence · references · confidence
                                  rationale. Automatically answers: why
                                  this exists.

  **Accountability Propagation**  Tracks: who confirmed · who corrected ·
                                  who entered information · who approved
                                  override. Automatically answers: who
                                  owns this.

  **Auditability Propagation**    Tracks: decision history ·
                                  recommendation changes · confidence
                                  changes · signal evolution.
                                  Automatically answers: what changed and
                                  why.

  **Compliance Propagation**      Tracks: regulatory obligations ·
                                  reporting triggers · policy exposure ·
                                  approval requirements. Automatically
                                  answers: what obligations exist.
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Invisible Compliance Principle**                                    |
|                                                                       |
| Trust travels with intelligence. Every signal carries governance      |
| across every screen.                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| Governance happens: without slowing work. Everything is:              |
| board-ready + audit-ready.                                            |
+=======================================================================+
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **14.4 --- Executive Design System SIM**
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
| **       | **Sacred Screen Anatomy**                                 |
| 14.4.1** |                                                           |
|          |                                                           |
| Full     |                                                           |
+==========+===========================================================+
+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+

Every CorpStage screen follows the same anatomy. Consistent executive
cognition across the Sacred 12. Every screen should feel: familiar ·
cognitively predictable · fast to understand · boardroom-grade · low
cognitive load.

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Screen Zone**              **Purpose and contents**
  ---------------------------- ------------------------------------------
  **Zone 1 --- Executive       Immediate executive orientation. Contains:
  Cognition Header**           screen purpose · executive question ·
                               enterprise posture · urgency indicator.
                               Answers: \"What is this screen trying to
                               help me understand?\" Position: Top ---
                               visually dominant.

  **Zone 2 --- Strategic       AI-generated executive story. Contains:
  Narrative Layer**            what changed · why it matters · business
                               consequence · recommendation summary.
                               Answers: \"Tell me what I need to know.\"
                               Position: Top-center priority. Narrative
                               before charts.

  **Zone 3 --- Primary         Core business intelligence. Contains: key
  Intelligence Layer**         signals · prioritization · trends · risks
                               · opportunities · readiness. Answers:
                               \"What is happening?\" Position: Center of
                               screen. Highest cognitive real estate.

  **Zone 4 --- Confidence      Show trust level. Contains: confidence
  Layer**                      score · evidence strength · uncertainty
                               visibility · assumption sensitivity.
                               Answers: \"How much should I trust this?\"
                               Position: Always visible but
                               non-intrusive. Persistent UI.

  **Zone 5 --- Action &        Translate intelligence into action.
  Recommendation Layer**       Contains: recommendations · interventions
                               · decisions required · escalation prompts.
                               Answers: \"What should happen next?\"
                               Position: Right-side / high visibility.

  **Zone 6 --- Explainability  Executive transparency. Contains:
  & Evidence Layer**           rationale · references · evidence lineage
                               · why recommendation exists. Answers:
                               \"Why are you saying this?\" Position:
                               Expandable, never cluttering. Invisible
                               until needed.

  **Zone 7 --- Human           Human-in-the-loop. Contains: Confirm /
  Interaction Layer**          Correct / Enter. Answers: \"What do you
                               need from me?\" Position: Persistent but
                               lightweight.
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Sacred Information Hierarchy**                                      |
|                                                                       |
| 1\. Meaning (what matters) → 2. Materiality (why important) → 3.      |
| Intelligence (supporting signals) → 4. Confidence (trust level) → 5.  |
| Recommendation (what to do) → 6. Evidence (why system believes this)  |
|                                                                       |
| Executives should never hunt for insight.                             |
+=======================================================================+
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+

+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
| **       | **Executive Attention Architecture**                      |
| 14.4.2** |                                                           |
|          |                                                           |
| Full     |                                                           |
+==========+===========================================================+
+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+

Guide attention intentionally --- not force executives to search.
Executives do not read screens. They: scan → orient → focus → decide. If
everything is loud, nothing is important.

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Attention Layer**             **Contents and visual priority**
  ------------------------------- ---------------------------------------
  **Layer 1 --- Meaning (First    Executive narrative, material business
  seen)**                         implication, what changed, why it
                                  matters. Answers: \"What is
                                  happening?\" Visual priority: Highest.

  **Layer 2 --- Materiality       Urgency, severity, enterprise impact,
  (Second focus)**                financial consequence. Answers: \"How
                                  important is this?\" Visual priority:
                                  Very high.

  **Layer 3 --- Recommendation    Recommended action, intervention
  (Third focus)**                 required, escalation need. Answers:
                                  \"What should we do?\" Visual priority:
                                  Action dominant.

  **Layer 4 --- Confidence        Confidence score, uncertainty,
  (Fourth focus)**                assumptions. Answers: \"How much should
                                  I trust this?\" Visual priority:
                                  Persistent but calm.

  **Layer 5 --- Supporting        Trends, evidence, signals, benchmarks.
  Intelligence (Fifth focus)**    Answers: \"Why is this true?\" Visual
                                  priority: Secondary.

  **Layer 6 --- Detail & Evidence References, audit trail, evidence
  (Last focus)**                  lineage. Answers: \"Show me proof.\"
                                  Visual priority: On demand.
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **CorpStage Attention Optimization**                                  |
|                                                                       |
| Universal executive eye flow: Narrative headline → Materiality →      |
| Recommended action → Confidence → Supporting intelligence → Evidence  |
| drill-down.                                                           |
|                                                                       |
| CorpStage optimizes for: 5-second understanding.                      |
+=======================================================================+
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+

+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
| **       | **Intelligence Narrative System**                         |
| 14.4.3** |                                                           |
|          |                                                           |
| Full     |                                                           |
+==========+===========================================================+
+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+

CorpStage communicates intelligence as meaning, not metrics. The
platform speaks like a trusted executive advisor --- not a dashboard.
Every insight follows a sacred narrative formula.

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Sacred Narrative Formula**                                          |
|                                                                       |
| What changed → Why it matters → Business consequence → Recommended    |
| action → Confidence qualifier                                         |
|                                                                       |
| Universal: Signal → Meaning → Consequence → Recommendation →          |
| Confidence                                                            |
|                                                                       |
| Bad: \"Operational delays increased.\"                                |
|                                                                       |
| Good: \"Execution readiness weakened as vendor delays now threaten Q3 |
| delivery timelines. Recommend supplier contingency activation.        |
| Confidence: High.\"                                                   |
+=======================================================================+
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Narrative Layer**             **Purpose and example**
  ------------------------------- ---------------------------------------
  **Layer 1 --- Executive         Instant understanding. \"Execution
  Headline (1 sentence)**         readiness deteriorated.\"

  **Layer 2 --- Strategic         Business context. \"Delivery delays in
  Explanation (2--3 sentences)**  two critical suppliers increased
                                  dependency exposure.\"

  **Layer 3 --- Recommended       Decision support. \"Recommend
  Action (short and direct)**     activating contingency sourcing.\"

  **Layer 4 --- Confidence        Trust. \"Confidence: Medium due to
  Context (minimal)**             incomplete vendor reporting.\"
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Narrative Rules**                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| Speak business-first (never framework-first) · Explain consequences   |
| (always answer \"Why should I care?\") · Be concise (boardroom        |
| language) · Be confidence-aware (uncertainty visible) · Avoid jargon  |
| · Recommend action (never stop at insight)                            |
+=======================================================================+
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+

+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
| **       | **Confidence Visual Language**                            |
| 14.4.4** |                                                           |
|          |                                                           |
| Full     |                                                           |
+==========+===========================================================+
+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Confidence        **Meaning and visual treatment**
  State**             
  ------------------- ---------------------------------------------------
  **High Confidence** Strong evidence. Recommendation stronger. Visual:
                      calm, stable, subtle reinforcement. Feeling: \"Safe
                      to act.\"

  **Medium            Partial uncertainty exists. Validation suggested.
  Confidence**        Visual: noticeable, balanced, reflective. Feeling:
                      \"Proceed thoughtfully.\"

  **Low Confidence**  Material uncertainty exists. Human intervention
                      required. Visual: elevated visibility,
                      caution-oriented, high explainability. Feeling:
                      \"Validate before action.\"
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Confidence Visual Rules**                                           |
|                                                                       |
| Rule 1 --- Confidence is persistent: Always visible, never hidden.    |
|                                                                       |
| Rule 2 --- Confidence is calm: Avoid alarmism. No blinking. No        |
| aggressive warning patterns.                                          |
|                                                                       |
| Rule 3 --- Confidence is contextual: Appears next to recommendations, |
| priorities, risks, readiness, interventions.                          |
|                                                                       |
| Rule 4 --- Confidence explains itself: Always expandable into \"Why   |
| confidence changed.\"                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| Rule 5 --- Low confidence increases visibility: More uncertainty →    |
| stronger prominence.                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| Rule 6 --- Confidence travels: Remains visible across screens,        |
| recommendations, decisions, readiness.                                |
+=======================================================================+
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+

+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
| **       | **Escalation & Intervention UX**                          |
| 14.4.5** |                                                           |
|          |                                                           |
| Full     |                                                           |
+==========+===========================================================+
+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+

CorpStage asks executives to act intelligently --- not through
notification spam. Four escalation levels, each with proportional visual
treatment and business consequence.

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Escalation Level**            **Purpose, meaning, and UX treatment**
  ------------------------------- ---------------------------------------
  **Level 1 --- Inform**          Awareness only. Important but no action
                                  needed. Examples: emerging trend,
                                  watch-list risk, weak signal. Executive
                                  expectation: stay informed. UX
                                  treatment: low prominence.

  **Level 2 --- Recommend**       Suggest action. Intervention
                                  beneficial. Examples: execution
                                  slowdown, rising dependency, moderate
                                  risk. Executive expectation: consider
                                  action. UX treatment: moderate
                                  prominence.

  **Level 3 --- Decide**          Decision required. Leadership judgment
                                  needed. Examples: major investment,
                                  strategic risk, resource conflict.
                                  Executive expectation: make a call. UX
                                  treatment: high prominence.

  **Level 4 --- Critical**        Immediate intervention. Material
                                  enterprise exposure. Examples: cyber
                                  breach, regulatory violation, failed
                                  strategic initiative. Executive
                                  expectation: intervene now. UX
                                  treatment: dominant placement.
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Intervention Experience Rules**                                     |
|                                                                       |
| Rule 1 --- Explain why (Why am I seeing this?) · Rule 2 --- Show      |
| business consequence (What happens if we ignore this?) · Rule 3 ---   |
| Show recommended action (What should happen next?) · Rule 4 --- Show  |
| confidence (How reliable is this?) · Rule 5 --- Show accountability   |
| (Who owns this?) · Rule 6 --- Avoid interruption overload (Escalate   |
| selectively).                                                         |
+=======================================================================+
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+

+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
| **       | **Explainability & Evidence UX**                          |
| 14.4.6** |                                                           |
|          |                                                           |
| Full     |                                                           |
+==========+===========================================================+
+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+

Trust through transparent reasoning. CorpStage explains intelligence
without overwhelming executives. Progressive disclosure: only reveal
depth when needed. No black boxes --- ever.

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Explainability Layer**        **Purpose, content, and visibility**
  ------------------------------- ---------------------------------------
  **Layer 1 --- Executive Reason  Fast understanding. Answers: Why this
  (Always visible)**              matters. \"Execution readiness weakened
                                  due to vendor dependency
                                  concentration.\"

  **Layer 2 --- Signal Drivers    Business explanation. Answers: What
  (One click away)**              caused this. Supplier delay increased +
                                  dependency concentration rose +
                                  contingency coverage weakened.

  **Layer 3 --- Evidence &        Trust. Answers: What supports this.
  Sources (Expandable)**          Includes: internal evidence, external
                                  intelligence, references, stakeholder
                                  inputs.

  **Layer 4 --- Assumptions &     Honesty. Answers: What could change
  Uncertainty (Persistent but     this. Examples: incomplete supplier
  lightweight)**                  data, pending stakeholder confirmation.

  **Layer 5 --- Decision Lineage  Traceability. Answers: How did we
  (On demand)**                   arrive here. Includes: recommendation
                                  evolution, confidence changes, prior
                                  interventions.
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
| **       | **Cross-Screen Interaction Grammar**                      |
| 14.4.7** |                                                           |
|          |                                                           |
| Full     |                                                           |
+==========+===========================================================+
+----------+-----------------------------------------------------------+

One interaction language across the Sacred 12. Executives never relearn
how to interact. Consistency creates confidence.

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Interaction Pattern**         **Definition and application**
  ------------------------------- ---------------------------------------
  **Pattern 1 --- Read →          Universal flow: Read (narrative first)
  Understand → Decide**           → Understand (signals + confidence) →
                                  Decide (action or intervention). No
                                  screen breaks this pattern.

  **Pattern 2 --- Progressive     Default: simple. Depth appears only
  Disclosure**                    when needed. Headline → Expand
                                  reasoning → Expand evidence → Expand
                                  audit lineage. Executives never start
                                  with clutter.

  **Pattern 3 --- Confidence      Confidence always appears next to
  Persistence**                   recommendations, risks, priorities,
                                  readiness, interventions. Never hidden.
                                  Never isolated.

  **Pattern 4 --- Explainability  Every recommendation has \"Why?\"
  Access**                        one-click access. Always consistent.

  **Pattern 5 --- Confirm /       Human interaction never changes.
  Correct / Enter**               Universal interaction grammar across
                                  all screens.

  **Pattern 6 --- Escalation      Every escalation follows: Inform /
  Consistency**                   Recommend / Decide / Critical. Same
                                  logic everywhere.
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **14.4.8 --- Sacred Design Principles Freeze --- CorpStage Executive
  Design Constitution**
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

The non-negotiable design constitution of CorpStage. These principles
protect executive cognition quality at scale. No screen, feature, or
future module should violate them. This is the design law of CorpStage.

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **P1**   **Cognition       CorpStage is a thinking system --- not a
           First**           dashboard. Every design decision must improve
                             executive understanding.
  -------- ----------------- ------------------------------------------------

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **P2**   **Narrative       Executives consume meaning first. Every screen
           Before Metrics**  must explain: what changed, why it matters, what
                             should happen --- before showing detail.
  -------- ----------------- ------------------------------------------------

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **P3**   **Materiality     Only material intelligence deserves attention.
           Over Volume**     Suppress noise, weak signals, low-relevance
                             data. Executives see what matters now.
  -------- ----------------- ------------------------------------------------

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **P4**   **Confidence      Confidence is persistent. Never hidden. Every
           Visibility**      recommendation must show how much trust exists.
  -------- ----------------- ------------------------------------------------

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **P5**   **Human-in-the-Loop**   CorpStage recommends. Humans decide. Universal
                                   interaction: Confirm / Correct / Enter. Human
                                   accountability never removed.
  -------- ----------------------- ------------------------------------------------

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **P6**   **Explainability   Every recommendation must answer: \"Why are you
           by Design**        saying this?\" No black boxes.
  -------- ------------------ ------------------------------------------------

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **P7**   **Progressive     Start simple. Reveal depth gradually. Executives
           Disclosure**      never begin with complexity.
  -------- ----------------- ------------------------------------------------

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **P8**   **Calm            Avoid: alarmist UX, flashing warnings, dashboard
           Intelligence**    panic. Urgency should feel: calm but serious.
  -------- ----------------- ------------------------------------------------

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **P9**   **One Interaction Every screen behaves consistently. Executives
           Language**        learn interaction once.
  -------- ----------------- ------------------------------------------------

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **P10**   **Invisible       Governance exists without becoming work. Always
            Governance**      preserve: auditability, traceability,
                              accountability, evidence lineage. Invisible to
                              executives.
  --------- ----------------- ------------------------------------------------

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **P11**   **Business        Never framework-first. Never compliance-first.
            First**           Never technology-first. Always: business
                              consequence first.
  --------- ----------------- ------------------------------------------------

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **P12**   **Executive       Complexity belongs underneath. The experience
            Simplicity**      should feel: boardroom-simple.
  --------- ----------------- ------------------------------------------------

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Design Anti-Patterns --- Forbidden**

CorpStage must never become any of the following. These are design
failures, not features.

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **✕**   **Dashboard Farm** Too many widgets competing for attention. Every
                             widget must earn its place.
  ------- ------------------ -----------------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **✕**   **Metric Dump**    Data without meaning. Numbers without
                             consequences. Information without judgment.
  ------- ------------------ -----------------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **✕**   **Traffic Light    Red/yellow/green overload. Creates alert
          Theater**          fatigue and false urgency.
  ------- ------------------ -----------------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **✕**   **Black Box AI**   Unexplained recommendations. Intelligence
                             without reasoning destroys executive trust.
  ------- ------------------ -----------------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **✕**   **Alert Spam**     Everything urgent. When everything is critical,
                             nothing is critical.
  ------- ------------------ -----------------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **✕**   **Click Maze**     Too much navigation required. Meaning must be
                             accessible without hunting.
  ------- ------------------ -----------------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **✕**   **Framework UX**   ESG/risk/compliance jargon dominating executive
                             screens. Frameworks are invisible backend
                             models.
  ------- ------------------ -----------------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **✕**   **Relearning       Every screen behaving differently. Cognitive
          Experience**       inconsistency breaks executive trust.
  ------- ------------------ -----------------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Design Decision Test --- Before Any Feature Ships**

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **7 Questions Every Feature Must Pass**                               |
|                                                                       |
| 1\. Does it improve cognition?                                        |
|                                                                       |
| 2\. Is it materially useful?                                          |
|                                                                       |
| 3\. Is confidence visible?                                            |
|                                                                       |
| 4\. Is it explainable?                                                |
|                                                                       |
| 5\. Is action clear?                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| 6\. Is governance preserved?                                          |
|                                                                       |
| 7\. Does it reduce cognitive load?                                    |
|                                                                       |
| 8\. Would a CEO use this in 30 seconds?                               |
|                                                                       |
| If any answer is no: do not ship.                                     |

|                                                                       |
| No framework acronym from this table appears on any screen visible to |
| an executive in the Executive or Risk Lens.                           |
|                                                                       |
| Every framework in this table is mapped automatically by the          |
| Regulatory & Commitment Intelligence domain (D-RC5).                  |

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **APPENDIX B --- Database Changes: v2.1 and v2.2**
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

Three new tables are required to support the Intelligent Work Routing
Engine (IDAL Stage 5a) and the Lens Model. Zero structural change to any
existing table in the 90+ table database. These are additive.

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Table**                      **Fields and Purpose**
  ------------------------------ ----------------------------------------------------
  **INTELLIGENCE_WORK_QUEUE**    element_id · confidence_score · materiality_score ·
                                 auto_allocated_to · allocated_at ·
                                 resolution_deadline · status (allocated / confirmed
                                 / corrected / delegated / escalated / resolved) ·
                                 escalation_level · financial_exposure_range. Tracks
                                 every unresolved intelligence element from
                                 auto-allocation through resolution. The engine that
                                 ensures nothing is ever unattended.

  **DOMAIN_OWNERSHIP_ROUTING**   domain_id · primary_owner_role ·
                                 secondary_owner_role · escalation_owner_role ·
                                 resolution_sla_hours. Drives the auto-allocation
                                 logic in Stage 5a. Updated when organisational
                                 structure changes --- a configuration change, not an
                                 engineering change.

  **DELEGATION_AUDIT_TRAIL**     element_id · delegated_from · delegated_to ·
                                 delegated_at · delegation_reason · accepted_at ·
                                 outcome. Immutable record of every delegation.
                                 Cannot be deleted --- only annotated. Supports audit
                                 and accountability requirements.

  **LENS_VOCABULARY_MAP**        lens_id · canonical_term · lens_term ·
                                 lens_priority_weight. One row per term per lens.
                                 Drives all vocabulary translation across the Lens
                                 Layer. The complete database footprint of the Lens
                                 Model --- one lookup table.
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
